claims.text: This explanation cannot release PAY-0057 or clear a hold. A conversation, including a vendor confirmation, does not change the control outcome. Decisions go through the approvals inbox.

The obligation is covered: the invoice was validated by a 3-way match and is unique.
Approval is covered: APR-0025 was approved via the approvals inbox by U-CTRL.
Execution is uncovered. PAY-0057 was executed to a payee account different from the one APR-0025 approved, so the approval does not bind the instruction. The gap is approval_binding.
